text: Alright what did i say the top most of the entire set needed to be, the selection. so is me holding a piece / prop before placement not the same as a selection ?
resolution: You were right — holding a piece/prop before placement IS a selection, and the top header ignored it. The paint header only read placed-and-selected pieces (selPieces), so while armed-but-not-yet-placed it said 'no selection'. Fixed: plumbed the armed/held item from the cart down through RightPanel into FacePainter (new HeldItem prop) and made the top 'selection' header resolve it — a placed selection still shows name + location (x/y/z, yaw); with nothing placed selected, the HELD item shows instead (its catalog name in cyan + a 'kind · holding — click in the build pane to place' sub-line; tower/water get sensible labels). So the topmost of the set now always reflects the current selection, held or placed. Built clean via SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship hmsc-int. Committed 34151dfe7. NEXT STEP if you want it: this only makes the held item the header IDENTITY — it doesn't yet let you skin the held item's faces/parts BEFORE placing (pre-placement skin staging that applies on drop). Say the word and I'll wire the faces + skin grid to operate on the held item too, so a prop can be dressed before it lands. Needs your rjit dev eyes (editor self-shot OOMs).
